body:
Maintainer request from #1572 ("make an issue of using cadmpeg as file importer then i suppose.. we could open all common cad parts into camcraft that way.").

## Goal
Run `cadmpeg` as an optional external CLI process from `camcraft-app` to convert native CAD files into STEP inside a strict sandbox, then import through the existing STEP pipeline.

## Scope
- Add an optional `cadmpeg_path: Option<String>` field to `ViewPrefs` in `crates/app/src/prefs.rs` (`camcraft-prefs/1`) so existing `prefs.json` files still load cleanly.
- Resolve the executable cleanly on desktop (`cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))`): check `cadmpeg_path` first if set, then search `PATH`. Return `CommandError::Needs` naming `cadmpeg` and the file extension when missing.
- Probe `cadmpeg --version` and enforce minimum version `0.6.12`. Probe `cadmpeg formats --json` to confirm STEP export and codec availability. Report old or unusable binaries via named `CommandError` variants (`CommandError::Needs` / `CommandError::Invalid`).
- Pass file paths directly through `std::process::Command::new` argv with no shell invocation.
- Run conversions inside a unique private directory under `std::env::temp_dir()` owned by an RAII `Drop` guard that removes the directory on success, error, or panic.
- Enforce a child execution timeout (kill on expiry), bounded stdout/stderr buffers, and `MAX_FILE_BYTES` output size limit (`crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs`).
- Execute `cadmpeg check --json <input>` and `cadmpeg convert <input> -o <step_out> --to step --reject-lossy=export` without `--allow-errors`. Refuse nonzero exits, blocking findings, or empty outputs by name.
- Pass converted STEP output into `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs` (`step::parse_open`) and all existing STEP guards (`step_depth`, `step_edge3d`, `step_closed::closed_shells`, `step_guard`, `step_refine`, `step_outward`).
- Replace the hardcoded `"iges" | "igs"` `CommandError::UnsupportedType` arm in `ImportModel::checked_budget` (`crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs`) with routing through the shared qualified-extension table. Keep the table empty until format qualification enables passing formats, and refuse unqualified extensions such as `L1` `.prt` by name.
- Add desktop unit tests using stub executables for success, missing binary, old version, nonzero `cadmpeg check`, timeout cleanup, oversized STEP refusal, and garbage output without touching `Cargo.toml` dependencies.

## Done means
`camcraft-app` resolves `cadmpeg`, enforces version `>= 0.6.12`, converts in a cleaned temp dir with timeout and size caps, refuses `check` errors by name, feeds output into `step::parse_open`, and passes stub-binary tests without new `Cargo.toml` crates.

Part of #1572
